cases.title: Dividing spots
cases.line: Three seeds split again and again until about forty blobs share the space.

cases.title: Swiss cheese
cases.line: The same chemistry with a little more feed: now the empty phase forms the droplets.

cases.title: Coral network
cases.line: Tubes branch and fuse into a single network that fills half the box.

cases.title: Perforated sheets
cases.line: What draws a maze in 2D stacks into layers in 3D, pierced by holes.

cases.title: Restless garden
cases.line: Spatiotemporal chaos: patches grow, split and vanish, and never settle.
